blocking_findings.issue: Cohort profiles and M8 evidence entries bind only creative_profile_id/version; the M6 identity also has policy_pack_digest and M8 LineageBinding carries policy_digest, so evidence or a seed can cross policy packs without M9_COHORT_LEAKAGE.
blocking_findings.fix: Add the creative policy-pack digest to cohort profiles and M8 evidence entries, bind it in profile/evidence-closure/candidate digests, and require equality with the server-resolved LineageBinding.policy_digest for queries, evidence use and seeding.

blocking_findings.fix: Add an erasable selected-content ref/integrity ref (or a normative deterministic resolution) bound in selected_content_digest, selection_closure_digest and replay tests.

blocking_findings.fix: Freeze created_by = M8 owner user_id; M9 command/bridge evidence keeps actor_id.
